books.title: 梅花易数
books.creator: 邵雍
books.comment: 万物皆可起卦。目前还停在认字的阶段，离掐指一算差得远，但这个看世界的坐标系本身就够有意思。
books.commentEn: Everything can be turned into a hexagram. Still at the learning-the-vocabulary stage, but the coordinate system itself is fascinating.

books.title: 周易
books.comment: 慢读，不求甚解。六十四卦是六十四种处境，隔几页就能对上一次当下。
books.commentEn: Reading slowly, without forcing understanding. Sixty-four hexagrams are sixty-four situations, and every few pages one of them matches the present.

movies.title: 师兄啊师兄
movies.creator: 玄机科技
movies.comment: 言归正传的原著，玄机的打斗。修仙界的苟系天花板——大师兄的稳健不是性格，是生存策略。
movies.commentEn: Yan Guizheng's novel, Xuanji's action scenes. The cultivation world's master of playing it safe — the senior brother's steadiness is not a personality trait, it's a survival strategy.

movies.title: 画江湖之不良人 第八季
movies.creator: 若森数字
movies.comment: 追了七季的老坑，十二年的恩怨还没清算完。第八季定档那天就是过年。
movies.commentEn: An old story seven seasons deep, its twelve-year feud still unsettled. The day season eight gets a release date will feel like New Year.

movies.title: 画江湖之岐王传
movies.creator: 若森数字
movies.comment: 不良人的衍生网络电影，讲岐王被囚十二年的故事。PV 已经出了，为了质量跳票。等。
movies.commentEn: A spin-off film about the Qig King's twelve imprisoned years. The PV is out, the release slipped for quality's sake. Waiting.

music.title: 沈园外
music.creator: 阿YueYue / 戾格
music.comment: 词写陆游和唐婉的沈园，把《钗头凤》的「错错错」唱成了流行旋律。越轻的编曲装越重的事。
music.commentEn: The lyrics tell the Shen Garden story of Lu You and Tang Wan — the 'wrong, wrong, wrong' of Chai Tou Feng set to a pop melody. The lighter the arrangement, the heavier the past it carries.
